channel.title: Business Insider Africa - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Africa (africa.businessinsider.com)

item.title: Rwanda opens legal battle with UK over cancelled migrant relocation plan
item.description: Rwanda has opened an international legal battle against the United Kingdom after Britain scrapped a controversial asylum agreement that would have seen migrants who entered the UK illegally relocated to the East African country.

item.title: Burkina Faso makes a decisive legal move as nuclear deal with Russia accelerates
item.description: Driven by its aspiration to establish nuclear programs in collaboration with partners such as Russia, Burkina Faso has formally acceded to the Vienna Convention on Civil Liability for Nuclear Damage.

item.title: Top 10 African countries with the strongest currencies at the start of 2026
item.description: A strong national currency is more than just the value of its exchange rates; it indicates stability, confidence, and economic strength, particularly for African countries.

item.title: Baume & Mercier: Inside the 195-year legacy of Swiss luxury watch sold by South African billionaire Johann Rupert
item.description: Swiss watchmaker Baume & Mercier, one of the world’s oldest continuously operating luxury timepiece brands, is entering a new chapter in its nearly 200-year history following a strategic sale by South African billionaire Johann Rupert’s Richemont Group.

item.title: Nigeria secures first-ever formal labour recruitment deal with Saudi Arabia
item.description: Saudi Arabia and Nigeria have signed their first-ever bilateral agreement on the recruitment of general workers, creating a formal labour corridor between Africa’s largest economy and the Middle East’s biggest labour market.

item.title: Zambia joins the ranks of Africa’s beaten-down economies, now recording huge wins
item.description: Several African economies, now including Zambia, which had in previous years encountered considerable economic challenges, have begun the new year with amazing economic gains.

item.title: Top 10 African countries with the lowest Chinese loans in the last 24 years
item.description: Over the last two decades, Chinese loans have played a significant role in shaping Africa's infrastructure.

item.title: FULL LIST: Meet the African billionaires who own luxury brands around the world
item.description: Africa’s roster of billionaires is a fascinating mix of industrial titans, financiers, and cultural influencers. Yet only a handful have direct or meaningful connections to luxury brands, whether through ownership, significant stakes, or founding luxury ventures.

item.title: Morocco to open $5.6 billion port hosting its first liquefied natural gas terminal
item.description: Morocco is set to bring its second Mediterranean deepwater port, Nador West Med, into operation in the fourth quarter of this year.

item.title: Cairo and Johannesburg ranked among the most powerful cities in the world
item.description: Africa made a modest but notable appearance in this year’s ranking of the world’s most powerful cities.
